kind: predeclared analytical local controls plus an unimplemented resolved comparison; not evidence, calibration or a run
mc01: OPEN: candidate mechanism selected; the resolved comparison below is not implemented or run

decision.route: the third route of the closure matrix case separation.bounded_rate_argument.separation_needs_one_of: an admitted failure law that creates a discontinuity, here a cohesion (bond) discontinuity
decision.supplies: a research decision and a prerequisite local slice (bond-state rule, band-equivalent strength and energy, exact local controls with retained elastic memory); not an admitted mechanism, event or split
decision.bond_rule: BONDED if the strength-controlling history is zero; UNRESOLVED if it is positive and either temperature or effective pressure lies outside the declared cohesion-loss support or the history is not recorded as accumulated wholly inside that support (UNKNOWN or VIOLATED; the current state never recertifies it); BROKEN if the residual state is declared broken_surface_sliding with provenance (which requires zero residual cohesion) and the history has reached kappa_c inside support; BONDED otherwise
decision.local_scope: the local control fixes temperature and effective pressure and has no healing and no geometry evolution; its softening_complete event is constitutive, and the bond state says separately whether it removed cohesion
decision.section_rule: a section separates only when no BONDED path of tracked crust, mantle lithosphere or their union joins the predeclared intact anchors across WELDED contacts; unresolved states are evaluated both ways; point-set connectivity is reported beside it and never decides an event; interval records compare two supplied graph summaries and are not time- or footprint-bound regional event certificates
decision.band_equivalence: uniform band of physical width w_s with Y softened linearly in kappa at fixed P_eff (the uniform local control): D_c = kappa_c w_s, G(P_eff) = (Y0 - Yr) D_c / 2, k_soft = (Y0 - Yr)/D_c; derived locally, never a universal fracture energy. Linear Y softening equals linear cohesion softening at constant friction; it is not assumed to substitute for a resolved convention that softens C and phi separately, for which G = w_s times the integral of (Y(kappa) - Yr) over [0, kappa_c] at the local P_eff

not_selected.singularity: only the constant-exponent power-law long-wave chain has a proven pinch-off; the retained mixed creep/plastic law's asymptote lies outside coefficient support (I01_BREAKUP_CLOSURE sections 4-6)
not_selected.state_change: melt extraction belongs to open MC-03; mantle-lithosphere reclassification needs an unselected I05 law and cannot remove a crustal bridge; pore-fluid and hydration routes are unowned (UR-07)

exclusions: creep and elastic loading never remove cohesion
plastic history outside the declared support is UNRESOLVED, never BROKEN
a residual declared weakened_intact never breaks
a broken_surface_sliding residual with nonzero residual cohesion is refused; no cohesive fracture threshold or numeric floor is invented
plastic history with an UNKNOWN or VIOLATED support record stays UNRESOLVED, also after the point returns inside the support
strength recovery, a lower filtered history or a mesh or filter change is not evidence of rejoining; reconnection needs its own admitted irreversible bond or surface history, not selected
tensile opening, universal fracture energy, pore-fluid and magma-assisted breakup are refused or unowned
no thickness, cell fraction, empty gap, detection level or ladder extrapolation enters the event; an unrepresentable positive thickness is refused, never returned as zero
obstructions: mixed necks: bonded creeping lower lithosphere keeps the union connected; through-lithosphere separation needs resolved embrittlement into the law's support or an admitted I05 reclassification law, neither selected

the retained D2 fixture inputs (ASPECT cookbook 20 MPa cohesion, 30 degree friction, each weakened by a factor 4) carry no residual-state semantics or cohesion-loss support, so their plastic history is UNRESOLVED until IN-04 supplies both

decision.energy_interfaces: W_ext = dE_elastic + D_creep + D_plastic per unit band area; D_plastic = realised breakdown (G at completion) + residual friction (Yr delta_p) + viscoplastic overstress; all dissipation goes to the D4 heat rule (IN-05); stored elastic change is never heat; no stress is reset; nothing is deleted

runnable_controls.provenance: analytical control values chosen for exact arithmetic (friction angle with sine 0.6 and cosine 0.8; round powers of ten); not planetary defaults, calibration or IN-04 inputs

law.provenance: analytical control law: cohesion softening at constant friction (the Lavier et al. 2000 equation 2 form) in the retained plane-strain convention; not a material calibration

exact_yield.given: review reproducer (separation-law review r1): a state exactly on the yield surface under a small net drive; unit analytical values with k = w_s = eta_v = eta_p = kappa_c = 1, Y0 = 2 and Yr = 0, so the net drive is delta = V - 2 as represented and k D_c/(Y0 - Yr) = 0.5; not material, calibration or planetary inputs

law.provenance: synthetic review reproducer; not a material calibration

exact_yield.equation: positive drive: kappa(t) = delta/2 (cosh(sqrt(2) t) - 1) and o(t) = delta sinh(sqrt(2) t)/sqrt(2); softening completes at t_c = acosh(1 + 2/delta)/sqrt(2) with traction sqrt(2 (1 + delta)); zero drive: stationary; negative drive: traction V + (2 - V) exp(-t), history zero

stable_completion.equation: X - 1 + exp(-X) = kappa_c (k w_s - s)^2 / (eta_p k V) = 8, with X = |g| t' after yield and |g| = (k w_s - s)/eta_p = 1.6e-12 s^-1
stable_completion.completion_traction: Yr + (k V / |g|)(1 - exp(-X)), with k V / |g| = 2.0e6 Pa

unstable_completion.equation: exp(X) - 1 - X = kappa_c (s - k w_s)^2 / (eta_p k V) = 8, with X = g t' after yield and g = (s - k w_s)/eta_p = 8.0e-13 s^-1

proposed_wording_corrections.current: Assess paths through reconstructed material in the declared domain, including interfaces and possible paths round the candidate cut.
proposed_wording_corrections.proposed: Assess bonded paths through reconstructed material in the declared domain, including possible paths round the candidate cut. A path may cross a welded material interface, such as crust to mantle, but not material or a surface whose admitted law has removed its cohesion. Contact across an admitted cohesionless surface is not a material connection; a bonded film of any positive thickness is one.
